item.title: Comment on USPS as a failed sovereign wealth fund by Data Scientist
item.description:
Shouldn't we think of the USPS as more as a piece of infrastructure? Publicly owned infra doesn't necessarily have to capture the wealth created, since the government can capture it in the form of a larger tax base. USPS can still be a failure of course, if it does a bad job at creating value in the first place.

item.title: Comment on USPS as a failed sovereign wealth fund by JD
item.description:
Using the same logic, you can also see the U.S. military as a failed sovereign wealth fund. It has even more land, buildings, trucks, etc, and it generates no revenue. It lost $800 billion on net in FY 2024, and has burned through trillions of dollars over the past 15 years.
It's about time we restructured the Dept of Defense to be run like a business, and generate an adequate return on investment!
